top_signals.title: Chinese Builder Logan Wins Court Approval for Debt Plan
top_signals.summary: A Hong Kong court gave Logan Group Co. clearance to implement its debt restructuring plan, more than four years after the Chinese developer defaulted in the midst of the country’s property crisis.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.
